name: medikoisk-monorepo
description: MediKiosk monorepo containing frontend kiosk app and backend API services

scripts.dev:backend: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('./backend/package.json')) { require('child_process').spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); } else { console.log('Backend not yet initialized. See backend/README.md to set up Node.js or Python.'); }"
scripts.build:backend: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('./backend/package.json')) { require('child_process').spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); } else { console.log('Backend build skipped (not yet initialized). See backend/README.md'); }"
